question: According to the division of the four yugas, what has been declared by the speaker concerning incarnation?
premises: A division of the four yugas is taken as the basis.
inference: By the division of the four yugas, the speaker has declared the incarnation.
uncertainties: The number and order of incarnations are not specified here.
plain_english: By the division of the four yugas, the incarnation has also been declared by me.
